reasoning: The unsafe verdict from qwen3 was based on a misinterpretation of the launcher script's runtime behavior, which falls outside AUR's build/install security scope. learnings: File selection: Models must prioritize files referenced in PKGBUILD functions (build/prepare/package) and source code executed during build. Launcher scripts should be lower priority.
Prompt/assessment quality: Models need stronger contextual training to distinguish build-time risks from runtime patterns.
Common failure modes: Over-alerting on dynamic path resolution in non-build scripts; under-prioritizing source code processed by build systems.
